tei:div.tei:p: 548) rang rnam tshigs bcad ma ku su la'i nyams byung gi gtam zhes bya ba bzhugs/ ༄༅// e ma ho/ chos sku'i zhing na ston pa kun tu bzang*/ longs sku'i zhing du rigs lnga gangs can mtsho// sprul sku rigs gsum mgon po pad+ma 'byung*// gdul bya'i khams su 'dren ston chos kyi rje// 'khor lo'i mgon po pad+ma las 'brel rtsal// gsob ba 'debs so bdag rgyud smin grol nas// bde chen 'khor lor rigs kyi bdag po ru// bzhugs la rab gsal blo gros snang ba stsol// chos sku kun bzang longs sku wa ra hi// sprul sku mkhar chen ye shes mtsho rgyal ma'i// gsung gi thugs sprul rdo rje zhi ba mtsho'i// sgyu 'phrul tsam du sngon byon skyes chen 'ga'i// rdo rje'i zhal lung rnams su gsal yod kyang*// kho mo rang ni skye lus dman pa dang*// shes rab chung zhing tha mal pa yi gzugs// thos bsam bsgom pa'i yon tan cung zad med// le lo g.yeng ba'i dmag gis rgyun du mnar// de 'dra'i lus dman skye ngan bdag lta bur// legs bshad yon tan 'byung tshul gsang ba'i gtam// nam mkha'i pad+mo'i dpe bzhin kun la gsal// 'on kyang rdo 549)rje'i mched po rnams gnyis kyi// gsung bskal nan cher phebs pa mi ldog tsam// sngon bsags bsod nams mthu las 'khrungs pa yis// legs bshad gnas tshul cung zhig 'di na spro// dbyings spyod ḍāk+ki'i tshogs kyis gnang ba stsol// sngon tshe thub pa'i spyan sngar ut+pa la// rgya gar yul du ro lang bde rol dang*// pad+ma'i drung du rdo rje zhi ba mtsho// li yi yul du bal mo byang chub sgron// de nas rim brgyurd bod yul lha ldan du// kun bzang bde skyong chos nyid dbang mo bdag /rigs bzang 'byor ldan dbang gi rigs las chad// chung nas chos la mos shing byang sems ldan// chos brgyad bya ba snying po med mthong nas// rtag tu dkon mchog gsum la gsol ba btab// de'i mthus lo brgyad dus su mkha' 'gro mas// rjes bzung byin rlabs gces pa'i bu bzhin bskyangs// rje btsun sgrol ma dge ma'i gzugs sprul nas// bdag rjes bzung ste sems bskyed bslab bya mdzad// kun dga' 'bum mas skyabs sdom la sogs kyi// chos kyi sgor btsud thar ba'i lam bstan mdzad// pha ma rigs bzang chos la blo dkar yang*// thob kyis len pa dpon gyi rigs yin phyir// lugs gnyis 'dres mar spyod pa'i chas su ni// zhugs nas lo shas 'bangs sde g.yog 'khor bskyangs// pha yi bka' phebs khyim pa'i gnas lam bstan// shin tu bzod dka'i sdug bsngal kyis mnar ba'i// gdung ba'i

550)dbyangs kyi pad 'byung mtsho rgyal dang*// dbyings dang dbyings bzhugs dpa' bo mkhar 'gro mar// gsol btab mthu yis 'khor ba'i skyen las bzlog /bcu gnyis dus su las kyi mthu sad nas// sa ra ha pas rjes bzung smin grol gyis// lam bstan 'khor lo bzhi ba'i man ngag skor// gdams pa tshangs sprugs gces nor tshul du bslabs// sbyangs pas rtsa rlung sgrib pa cung zad srab// rtags drug zhugs gnas thim pa'i drod tshad mthong*// dngos dang dngos med lha 'dre'i cho 'phrul gyis// rtogs pa'i bogs thon rig pa'i ye shes mjal// snang sems lha 'dre'i gzugs su shar shes nas// rtogs pa'i 'dra 'bag sems kyis bcos ma dgos// lha 'dre gdul bya'i yul du re zhig bskyangs// bcu gsum dus su sngon bsags smon lam mthus// grub pa'i dbang phyug ku ku pa dang mjal// rtsa rlung gegs sel man ngag ngo sprod bstan// 'khor lo lnga la brten nas phyi nang gi// phyag rgya'i lo rim gsang ba'i chos rnams bstan// snying ka'i rtsa mdud grol ba'i mthus bskul nas// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i brda' byang 'phyugs med sprad// pad 'byung mtsho rgyal rnams kyi zhal dngos mjal// ma dang mkha' 'gro'i pho nyar mnga' gsol nas// 'gro don dus babs yod pa'i lung bstan cing*// don gnyis rim gyis 'byung ba'i bslab bya mdzad// mdo khams bdud sde srin po'i yul phyogs 551)su// grogs dang chos bdag gdul bya de la yod// dman pa'i tshul gyis yul gsum thabs kyis bsten// zhes sogs lung bstan bslab bya du ma mdzad// mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod gnyis kyi bka' dbang thob// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur lung bstan brda' byang gtad// ma 'ongs 'brel thog dang bcas mkha' 'gro'i gling*// rang snang dag pa'i zhing du 'dren nus zhes// bka' yi zhal tshab brda' yi ris su gnang*// [

rdo rje ]g.yu sgron ma yis grogs byas te/ 'byung 'gyur brda byang yi ge'i ris su mdzad/ khyad par rigs lnga'i sems dpa' brtag thabs dang*// 'gugs sbyangs smin pa'i las kyi bslab bya mdzad// rig 'dzin dang ni o rgyan zangs gling dang*// mkha' 'gro'i brda' sogs yig ris dper sprad nas// 'byung dang 'byung 'gyur brda yi man ngag gnang*// de'i mthus gzugs med lha 'dre'i 'gro don 'byung*// gnyan chen la sogs bod skyong gzhi bdag gis// mthun rkyen sgrub cing gter kha phran bu re// sprad kyang bod khams bde phyir yang gter sbas// de skabs dge slong kun dga' 'bum ma zhes// yin par skad pa'i btsun ma zhig na re// khyed kyi stong pa nyid kyi don e shes// stong pa nyid kyi don te ma rtogs na// lus ngag dge la bskul kyang don 'bras chung*// gces 'dzin 'chang ba dam pos kun dkris nas// tshe 'dir dge sdig cha mnyam spyad pa yi// 'bras 552)bu mtho ris gsum dang ngan song rnams// res mos spyad cing 'khor ba mtha' med gnas// de phyir khyod kyis shes rab mig ma longs// blang dor mkhas pas sems kyi gsang chen po// rang la gnas pa'i ye shes nyams su longs// zhes gsungs de la bdag gis 'di skad zhus// sku gsum mkha' 'gro'i gtso mo wa ra hi// ye shes sgyu ma'i skur bzhengs rnal 'byor ma// khyed la mi phyed dad pas gsol ba 'debs// bdag la sems kyi gsang ba bstan du gsol// tshe 'dir srid pa 'khor bar mi gnas par// rje btsun khyed rang lta bur byin gyis rlobs// zhes zhus rje btsun ma yis 'di skad gsungs// e ma nyon dang skal ldan las 'phro can// sems kyi gsang ba'i man ngag bstan pa ni// dang po sgo gsum rnal du dbab byed pa// lus gnad rnam par snang mdzad chos bdun dang*// ngag gnad smra bcad rgyud mang sgra chad ltar// smra bar mi brtson ngag rlung rang sar bzhag

/sems gnad ma bcos gsal stong ngang la zhog /gsal ba longs sku stong pa'i ngo bo chos sku// 'phro 'dus rtsal snang gang shar sprul ba'i sku// sku gsum dbyer med rig pa gzhi la rdzogs// dbang rab rig pa rang snang blo can gyi// spyod yul man ngag 'di nyid mchog tu zab// dbang 'bring dbang po yul gyi blo can la// sgo gsum ru shan nas bzung byung gnas sogs// sems kyi khang bu bshig pa'i man ngag 553)dgos// khyod ni byis pa le lo ma che bar// bdag gis gdams pa'i man ngag zab mo rnams// yal bar ma dor rang rgyud lon par mdzod// stong nyid lta ba zer kyang de las med// sku gsum rig pa zer yang de las med// rang byung ye shes chen po de nyid do// de las lhag pa'i sems kyi gsang ba ni// stong gsum kun tu btsal kyang rnyed mi 'gyur// rang sems rtogs pas sangs rgyas dngos yin phyir// sangs rgyas zhes pa gzhan du ma tshol ang*// de skad gsungs nas nam mkhar 'ja' ltar yal// bdag gis mkha' 'gro'i gsung bzhin nyams len la// shi mthar thug gi bar du brtson par chad// rang lo bcu bzhi nas bzung bco brgyad bar// chos phyir lus dang ngag gi dka' ba spyad// zla ba re tsam zas kham gcig med kyang*// chos min bya ba bdag gis byed pa med// chung nas bla ma dkon mchog gsum dang ni// lhag pa'i lha la blo gtad ling gis bkal// sdug bsngal bzod dka' ci dang ci byung yang*// thams cad rang gi sngon bsags las yin bsam// tshe 'dir dam chos rnam dag zhig med na// spyir na sems can sgos su pha ma yi// drin chen drin lan bdag gis 'khor thabs bral// bsam zhing rang yul srin po'i gling 'dra ba// spangs nas dka' spyad snying rus chen po yis// mdo smad shar phyogs mgo log yul gling du// sngon kyi smon lam las 'phro'i stobs 554)kyis 'phangs// rang nyid lus dman longs spyod dbul ba yis// 'gro ba kun gyis brnyas dmod sna tshogs byed// zab pa sa yi gter la dbang na yang*// grogs dang chos bdag gzhan rkyen sab+tas bsgyur// de ltar rkyen ngan du mas mnar ba'i tshe// bdag gis dbyings spyod ḍāk+kis dkyil 'khor la// tshogs kyi mchod pa phul nas 'di skad bskul// kye ma kye hud ye she mkha' 'gro rnams// thugs rje zhi ba'i dbyings su mi gzims par// las ngan kho mo bdag la thugs rjes gzigs// ji ltar byas kyang mkha' 'gro'i bka' lung bzhin// bdag gi bstan 'gro'i don te 'byung ba dka'// snyigs dus 'gro ba log spyod bdud kyis bslus// chos bzhin spyod pa nyin mo'i skar ma tsam// dkor nag log 'tsho'i zas la sman bzhin mthong*// rang mgo mi thon gzhan mgo g.yo sgyus skor// gshin po'i ro dom gson po'i dad zas len// las 'bras khyad bsad mi dge sna tshogs spyod// de 'dra'i snyigs dus rang rtags ngom pa'i tshe// bdag 'dras bstan 'gro'i rgud pa ci'i phyir sel// mi rnams rgyud gyong log lta che ba yis// phar la gces par bskyang yang tshur la sdang*// chos dang mthun par spyad na glen pa zer// rgyal ba'i bka' bzhin bdag bas gzhan gces kyi// bzang ngan ro mnyam bzod pa'i go bgos kyang*// bzang ngan mi shis mi ngan khyi 'dra zer// de la

555)sogs pa'i ngan smad sna tshogs kyis// bdag la yon tan med pa'i tshul mthong ste// brnyas dmod log par lta ba'i gzhir gyur bas// 'gro don [ mi 'ong ]rang gzhan phung ba'i rgyu// de phyir bdag gi lus ngan 'di bor nas// chos ldan skyes pa'i lus su bdag smon te// gu ru yab yum thugs bzhed 'grub pa dang*// ḍāk+ki'i bka' bzhin bstan 'gror sman thabs brtson// ye shes dbyings bzhugs rnams kyi da dgongs 'tshal// ces pa'i 'o dod drag pos 'bod pa'i mthus// dbyings kyi sprul ba dbyings kyi rgyan shar ba// dbyings kyi yum chen dbyings phyug kun gsal ma// dbyings snang ḍāk+ka'i brda' gsang 'di skad ngom/ e e/ shar nam mkha'i nor bu 'od gsal ba// 'gro'i mun pa gsal ba phyogs ris med// ma mkha' 'gros bskul ba'i pho nya la// lus bzang ngan phyogs ris ci la srid// rang gdul zhing smon lam 'phro la rag /khyod thugs ngal skyo sun ma mdzad dang*// khyod rang lo brgyad nas bcu bzhi'i bar// sngon pad+ma mtsho skyid smon lam mthus// lha 'dre yi 'gro don cung zad smin// de rang mthong ma chen sngon las yin// bco lnga nas nyi shu la babs tshe// las sdug bsngal bzod dka' du ma myong*// yid ma gzhom ( zhum )las kyi mtha' ma yin// rtsa gcig nas rtsa brgyad la thug tshe// yul gdul zhing snyigs ma'i rkyen dbang gis// ngan 'brel las bzang 'brel shin tu dkon// blo 556)yid gnyis med par pad 'byung dang*// ma mtsho rgyal la gsol 'debs brtson nus na// de phan chad rang skal gter grogs dang*// las ldan gyi chos 'dzin dang 'phrad nas// bstan 'gro ba'i don chen rim gyis 'byung*// bzang 'brel las ngan 'brel rim gyis nyung*// slar bzang ngan gang gis 'brel gyur kyang*// de khyod kyi gdul bya'i zhing yin pas// chags sdang dang dga' sdug spyod pa spongs// mnyam nyid kyis rdzong mkhar ma zhen[

zhig ]dgos// ma mkha' 'gros mngag pa'i pho nya la// rten 'brel gyi chos la rag las pas// thabs mkhas pa'i tshul gyis gzab gal che// rang gter ston e 'ong rang gis shes// dbyings ḍāk+kis bka' bzhin ma bsgrubs na// chos gter la dbang yang sab+tas bsgrib// las mi 'dod sna 'dren rang gis byed// khyed gter la dbang yang gzhan rkyen 'ong*// chos mi ngor shor nas khyim thabs 'dzin// rang gter gyi bya ba phag tu yib// las 'di 'dra byed pa a re sdug /ma mkha' 'gro'i zhal lung bzhin bsgrub na// khyod tshe 'dir don gnyis 'byung bar nges// brda' go'am rigs ldan gzhon nu ma// zer bar snang dbyings su 'od du yal// bcu dgu nas bzung nyi shu rtsa brgyad bar// skyid sdug ma nges chu yi gnyer ma bzhin// 'byung zhing phyed ka chos kyi phyogs dang ni// phyed cha 'jig rten phyogs su sdug bsngal myong*/ khyad par dbang thob bla ma'i 557)bka' bzhin du// khyim thabs 'dzin cing 'khor ba'i bya bar brtson// mi ngo lon pa'i dus ni nga ma byung*// rkyen des bskal nas 'khor bar blo sun te// mi mngon dpal rir zhing du 'gro snyam tshe// mi min yul gyi bu mo mdzes ma gnyis// rin chen du mas brgyan cing ngag snyan sgras// e ma gson dang grogs mo// nga gnyis khyod kyis shes sam// mi mngon zhing nas 'ong ba'i// bzhin mdzes ḍāk+ki nged gnyis// khyod la ngag gsal sgrog 'ong*// bde bde mkha' 'gro'i grod dang*// grigs khyed byon na legs sam /dus ngan mi yi blo sems// bdud dbang bsgyur ba med dam// grong la 'thab mkhon ma byed// nyams pa'i grib gyis 'tshe ba// khyod la ldang 'ong e nam// mi mo gsal gyi ming can// khyod kyi dge ba'i bskul ma// de la chags sdang spongs la// gang dkar bzhag pa e nam /lho yi lcags sbrul smug chung*// sgra brgya'i gtsug tu 'chang na// ring min nye nas don gnyis// nor bu lon pa e nam// da lan nged cag gnas su// khyod bsgrod stabs ldan med tshe// cang shes cang shes lo yi// skyes bu de yis bskul nas// badz+ra ming gi mthun rkyen// dus su 'dzom pa e nam// lo gsum zla gsum bar du// mi yi sgyu 'phrul spangs nas// sgrub pa nyams len brtson na// mkha' 'gro'i dus tshigs 'chugs med// sa ga zla ba'i 'bod pa// phran bu des sel e nam// las dang bya ba gang byed/

558)ḍāk+kis zhal lung ci bzhin// khyed kyis legasapar bsgrub na// gter gnyis bstan pa'i ba dan// khyod la dbang ba e dan// dus dang dus su 'byung 'gyur// brda don khyod la smra 'ong*// gzhan la ma smra gsang rgya// tsit+ta'i klong du sbas mdzod// ces zer nam mkha'i klong du 'ja' ltar yal/ rkyen des 'byung 'dus cung zhig 'khrugs pa dang*// gter chen karma[ gling pa'i ]sprul ba dngos// 'jigs bral chos kyi blo gros rin po ches// mkhyen bzhin chos dam gnyan po'i bka' gnad kyis// bdag nyid mkha' 'gro'i bka' bzhin 'gro thabs dben// de skabs zhig la gu ru yin skad pa'i// paṇ+ḍi ta yi cha byad dge btsun zhig /bdag ni phyugs rdzir yod pas der thon nas// khyod kyis nga ni e shes lan gsum zer// bdag gi smras pa gu ru khyed yin na// dus gsum mkhyen pa'i mngon shes khyed la mnga'// mdzad pa bsam yas rdzu 'phrul thogs pa med// dngos grub mchog brnyes 'dren pa kun gyi gtso// bla med bla ma khyed la gus phyag 'tshal// bdag dang bdag la 'brel bcas 'gro ba kun// tshe 'di'i snang ba nub par gyur ma thag /rje btsun gu ru khyed dang dbyer med cing*// chos dbyings gdod ma'i klong du byang chub shog/ ces gsol dge sbyong zhal nas 'di skad gsung*// nga ni rgyu med rkyen med sprul ba'i sku// 'gro ba'i don du rang byung lhun gyis grub// dge sbyong bdag la 'gro ba'i don las med/ 559) lus med lus mchog rdo rje'i sku brnyes phyir// sor skyes rnams ni pad 'byung zhalargyang ring*// sngon smon stobs dang mos pas rgyud bskul na// dad pa can gyi pad 'byung dus drug tu// zhal mjal gdangs ( gsungs thos yin nam snyam )thos dgongs rgyud byin rlabs thob// khyod kyang las 'phro ldan pas nga dang mjal// thabs kyi grogs la the tshom skyes gyur pas// nga nyid tha mal lus can dge sbyong mthong*// da ni rang skal gter la spyod 'dod na// 'di nas nyi ma lho phyogs nye cha nas// nga min nga dang gnyis med gter spyod mkhan// rdo rje'i rigs can sems dpa' rasma'i mtshan// dpa' bo de dang khyed gnyis lhan 'dzom na// lho nas lho ru gter gnyis bstan pa dar// lcags sbrul nag po 'brug gi lto bar snyan// ngang pa'i khyu tshogs phyogs nas sprin bzhin 'du/

kha ta nag po'i dug char ma btang na// drug cu'i bar du mtha' dmag dus 'khrugs gzhom// bod khams bde skyid nyi ma cung zhig 'char// rang gter kha byang bzhin du dus rtags dang*// rten 'brel la sogs gnad zab gal che'o// zhes gsungs rkyen des snang ba gnas gyur te// dag pa mkha' 'gro'i tshogs gral la slebs nas// ka la ping ka'i brda' yi rgyud mang las// zab gter chos kyi kha byang 'bring bu lon// phral der bi ma rasmis rjes bzung nas// gangs ri gnyis pa rma chen spom ra yi// nub sgo dbang phyug ma bdun nye 'khor 560)bcas// chos nyid mkha' 'gro'i gsang mdzod zab gter drangs// gzhan yang smon grub a shwa'i mchod sdong dang*// lcags ri 'od 'bar dang ni sdong rong gnas/ khyung brag rtse dang pad+ma ri mtho dang*// sprel rdzong la sogs gnas chen gnas phran nas// res 'ga' chos gter res 'ga' zab gter ston// de dag rnams kyi skabs su lung bstan sogs// du ma[ byung yang ]gdul zhing snyigs rkyen gyis// rten dang 'brel 'byung sab+ta'i dbang du song*// dus babs rten 'brel ldan pa'i zab chos ni// dper na chu rdol sa yis mi khogs ltar// rkyen ngan rlung ltar 'tshub yang ya nga med// skal ldan chos rgyud 'dzin pa'ang ngang gis sprad// chos brgyud bya ba thabs kyis spangs nus byung*// rtsa dgu nas bzung sum cu rtsa gnyis bar// phral gyi rkyen dang sngon gyi las smin nas// grogs kyis dor nas dgos med khyi bzhin phud// mi bzod nad gzhi drag pos rkyen bskul te// skyabs rje 'khor lo'i mgon po las 'brel bas// rjes bzung smin grol gdams pa'i chos mdzod kyis// bdag blo'i ma rig mun pa drungs 'byin nas// shes rab ye shes sko brgya'i gsang mdzad 'byed// thos bsam yon tan nor gyis phyug par mdzad/ khyad par nang don ye shes mngon sum du// sad cing zung 'jug phyag rgyas grol lam thob// de'i mthus phyi yi gdul bya snyan grags rgyas// nang du dbu mgrin rtsa

561)yi bdud rgya grol// gsang ba mi rtog ye shes mngon gyur nas// zab gter 'bri spel bstan pa ches cher rgyas// 'gro don gdul bya chad med ngang gis dar// lha dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag tshogs// lus dang grib bzhin 'grogs nas mthun rkyen bsgrubs// lung bstan bslab bya gsungs pa gzhan du gsal// skabs shig 'gro 'dul dpa' bos bkas bskul nas// khrom gyi rdo ra brag dkar nye cha na// gnas bcas yod skabs mi min bu mo bzhi// stag seng dom dang sgra ( smra )mkhas gdong can bzhi// mgrin gcig snyan pa'i dbyangs kyis 'di skad zer// ha ya he// gson dang rnal 'byor dbang mo// ti gro mkha' 'gro'i rdzong nas// kun gzigs ye shes dbang mos// khyod la ngag gsal bskur yod// gnas mchog rdo rje brag rdzong*// rdo rje mkha' 'gro'i 'du rar// zab chos dgongs pa 'dus pa// ḍāk+ki'i thugs kyi ṭī ka /dus babs rten 'brel legs pa'i// a k+ṣa'i dpal du shar ba// dus ni cang shes ngom dus// nye min ring nas srung ma'i// khyod la rang gter sprad nges// zab phyir 'tshub slong che bas// de la stabs ka gzab dgos// kun gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor// sa 'dzin 'khun pa'i sgra yis// chu 'dzin nag po bskul nas// gsal byed gzi mdangs nyams srid// de la shes rab ma zhan// snyan snyan tshig gis mdun bsus// mi snying gdon gyis bsgyur nas// mi 'dod 562)yo lang sna tshogs// smra[

sgra ]ming 'dzin gyis bskul la// ci cha ci 'gyur ci yong*// dus su 'byung 'gyur nges tshig /ḍāk+ki'i brda gsal ngom 'ong*// e go e go grogs mo// zhes zer lan du bdag gis// khyod cag su yin dris tshe// gtam mjug ma rdzogs gzhan rkyen zhig gis ni// gnyid las sad cing nyams snang rang sar yal// 'on kyang ḍāk+ki'i brda' byang ji bzhin du// zab gter spyan drangs 'bri spel gsal khyab byas// de skabs ko 'jo'i rgyal po yin skad pa'i// mi nag la ba dkar po can zhig gis// 'jigs pa'i ngar skad chen pos 'di skad zer// khyod ni ma nges pa yi bud med zhig /yul 'dir 'ong don ci yin gang nas 'ong*// 'di ru ma 'dug 'u cag rtsod pa 'ong*// de bas bde skabs khyod rang yul gzhan song*/ zhes zer am gtsigs bsdams nas zhe sdang ngom// bdag gis smras pa khyod 'dra'i las ngan gyis// ma nges pa yi mi zhig ngas ma mthong*// khrom khog 'di ni rgya bod kun gyi lam// khyod rang gcig pur thob pa ngas ma go// 'on kyang nga ni yul dang pha ma med// gcig pur rgyal khams gang bder 'gro ba yin// lus dang longs spyod gces 'dzin bdag la med// las ngan 'khrul ba'i lha 'drer 'gyed du btang*// gzugs can gzugs med kun la snyem thag chod// gang shar gang snang sems kyi cho 'phrul shes// gces 'dzin 'khrul snang bshig pa'i 563)gdams pa yod// glo bur rkyen las khyod 'dra yid gzugs shar// phan dang gnod med thams cad chos sku'i rtsal// yum chen skye med dgongs ( pa'i )klong ( du )phaṭa/ zhes brjod rig stong mtha' bral chen po'i ngang*// dag mnyam dbyings su cung zhig ngal bsos tshe// 'khrul snang rmi lam lta bu dbyings su yal// so gsum nas bzung da la thug gi bar// rang nyid bsod nams chung ba'i rkyen dbang gis// skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa snying gi nor// pad+ma las 'brel mkha' 'gro'i gling du gshegs// kho mo bdag ni mgon med shul du bor// gnas dang grogs med sa mthar spyugs nas kyang*// kun gyi mig la tsher ma lta bur gzen// skyabs rje bla ma'i thugs kyi sras gcig pu// rdo rje'i mched po sna tshogs rang grol pas// khyed ni bka' drin can gyi gzungs ma mchog

/yin phyir thag ring yul du spyugs pa dben// gsungs te chos dam gnyan po dpang bzhag mdzad// rkyen des sems shes ser dgon gnas su bsdad// gter chen yab sras gnyis kyi zab chos rnams// 'dzin skyong spel sogs skyabs rje'i bka' gnang ltar// nye ring kun la zab gter dar rgyas spel/ khyad par chos bdag pra dz+nyā rasmi'i gtso// las can rnams la gter gnyis pha phogs gtad// gzhan yang skal ldan grangs las 'das pa yis// zab chos nyams blangs dben par sgrub tshugs 'dzin// don gnyis 564)mdzad pas gter gnyis bstan pa bskyangs// skyabs rje bla ma'i yang srid khrir 'khod tshe// bdag gi sems kyi sdug bsngal cung zad zhig// 'on kyang bdag 'dra'i nor skyong gyi na bar// g.yu ral ldan pa'i seng ge'i ming thob pa// skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i drin las byung*// de don bsam na sems skyo dwangs dus med// kun gsal rta bdun dkyil 'khor mthong ba'i tshe// skyabs rje yid bzhin nor bu'i sku dkyil dran// 'od kyis phyogs kun mun pa sel ba'i dus// thugs rje phyogs ris med pa'i yon tan dran*// steng phyogs nam mkha'i klong nas nub rir phyogs// rje nyid bdag cag 'gro ba'i mgon byon nas// gzugs sku mya ngan 'das pa'i bkod pa dran// mkha' klong yang ba'i dbyings nyid mthong ba'i tshe// gzhi dbyings dag pa chen pa'i klong nyid nas// rang byung lhun grub gzung ba'i snang ba dran// brda rtags ci dang ci mthong ci shar yang*// skyabs rje bla ma yid bzhin nor bu dran// dben gnas gang du bsdad kyang bla ma dran// nyams len gdams ngag dran tshe bla ma dran// gzhung bzang mched grogs mthong tshe bla ma dran// ci dang ci la bsam kyang bla ma dran// 'dren ston pad+ma las 'brel kho rang dran// dran nas dus kun gsal byed chu rgyun 'bebs// blo sems gdung bas skyo nas dran pa 'khrul// rtag tu bsten pa skad cig yud tsam 'dra// smin grol thob pa mnga'

565)yang skad cig tsam// 'di 'dra'i bkod pa dran tshe kye ma hud// sku zhal mthong tshe dad mos gting nas skye// gsung thos tsam gyis smin grol lam sna zin// thugs kyi dgongs pa'i gsang mdzod sgo brgya 'byed// 'gro ba'i khams dbang dang bstun chos char 'bebs// 'gro rnams 'khor ba'i 'phrang las thar bar mdzad// gtan bde bla med go 'phang mchog brnyes nas// gdod ma'i dbyings su grol ba'i ded dpon mdzad// bka' drin bsam las 'das shing 'khor thabs bral// de don bsam zhing gdung bas rgyud bskul nas// rje btsun bla ma dran pa'i smra sngags shor// 'on kyang bla ma'i sku drin gso phyir du// rang don yid byed blo ngan rgyang spangs nas// skal ldan rnams la zab gter 'chad spel dang*// sgo gsum bya ba chos dang mthun byas te// bse ru lta bur dben par sgrub tshugs bzung*// gter la dbang yang gter spyod ngas mi thon// pha chos bu yis 'dzin na des chog snyam// rang gter zab mo sa yi gter gnas ni// sku yi gnas gsum thugs kyi gnas gsum dang*// brag dkar gsum dang rdzong gsum sbas gnas gnyis// de dag gter gyi gnas su bshad pa yin// zab pa'i chos kyang rtsa ba sdong po dang*// yal ga me tog dang ni 'bras bu'i chos// sa gzhi lta bu'i dgongs pa mi 'gyur gter// phrin las kha tshar gter ni bsam mi khyab// gter gyi grogs kyang 566)mchog gnyis rab gsum dang*// rigs lnga'i char gtogs sems dpa' chen po lnga// chos kyi bdag po bka' bab bu bzhi dang/ mchog brgyad dang ni nyer lnga brgya rtsa sogs// byung nas rim gnyis 'bras bu tshe 'dir lon// chos gter 'byed pa'i dus rtags rten 'brel sogs// kha byang dang ni yang byang snying byang dang*// zur byang la sogs skabs don ḍāk+kis sprad// 'gro don gdul zhing yul lnga khyad par du// shar kyi phyogs dang lho ru dar bar bstan// de ltar rang gter rtsa tshig mdor bsdus 'dis// skal bzang bu slob rnams kyi bzhed skong phyin// don chung tshegs che phrin las yig gzugs bkod// tha mal so skyes lus dman bdag lta bur// legs bshad gsang ba'i yon tan ci'i phyir snang*// 'on kyang brgyud ldan bla ma'i thugs rje dang*// tshogs gnyis 'bras bu smin pa'i don dam gyis// skye phreng du mar chos ldan lus thob nas// rigs can rnams kyi thugs kyi dgyes pa bskyed// zab gter mnga' bdag pad+ma gling pa yis// rjes bzung smin grol chos kyis dbugs dbyung ba'i// sngon gyi 'phro sad zab gter phran bu dbang*// de nas rim brgyud skye phreng cha shas su// zab mo gter gyi dngos grub phran re dbang*// 'khor slob gdul bya bskyang 'dod blo med kyang*// smon lam dbang gis gdul bya thabs kyis bskyangs// legs bshad gsang ba'i yon tan tshang med kyang*/

567)/rang gi gnas tshul mdor bsdus phyogs tsam 'di// thob thang chos brgyad sngon bsu byas pa min// skal bzang slob bu rnams kyi kha ma bcag /rdzun tshig yi ge'i ris su bris pa yi// dge 'dis bstan 'dzin skyes bu'i zhabs pad brtan// phyi nang rten 'brel legs 'grig bsod nams 'phel// snod bcud yongs kyi rgud pa mtha' dag sel// dmag 'khrug mu ge'i bskal ngan kun zhi nas// zab gter bstan pa phyogs bcur ba dang*// der 'dzin skye bu'i mdzad phrin rgyas par shog /sbyin bdag mnga' thang longs spyod gong 'phel rgyas// sems can bde skyid phun tshogs chos la spyod// kun kyang bdag gis gdul bya'i zhing gyur nas// rnga yab pad+ma 'od kyi pho brang du// rig 'dzin dpa' bo mkha' 'gros mdun bsus te// gu ru sid+dhi'i glu dbyangs len bzhin du// pad+ma 'gro 'dul gling dang dbyer med par/ o rgyan mkha' gro'i gling du skyes nas kyang*// ston 'khor dgongs pa dbyer med sangs rgyas shog/ ces pa ku su li'i nyams byung gi gtam 'di yang skyabs rje thams cad mkhyen pa mtshan brjod par dka' na'ang don gyi slad du smros na grub pa'i dbang phyug rig pa 'dzin pa chen po skyabs rje dge legs dpal bzang po'i dngos slob rdo rje'i spun grogs shākya'i dge btsun dam pa rtog bral nam mkha'i rnal 'byor ba don li dang rang byung gnyis nas rin chen gnyis pa dang lha reg dri bral bcas dus ring mo nas nan cher bskul ba dang*/ rang slob bya bral shes rab 'od zer nas kyang zab gter gsum gyi rten bzhengs dang tshe 'dir dben 568) khrod kho nar 'dug cing zab chos 'dzin skyong ci nus byed pa dang*/ khyad par sgo gsum bla ma'i phyogs su 'bul zhing chos min gyi bya ba ring du spangs nas sgrub pa lhur len byed pa sogs kyis yang yang nan tan chen pos bskul ba dang*/
